# Instagram queue

<!-- Generated by tools/instagram/instagram.mjs queue. Do not edit by hand: change the post folders instead. -->

Posts that are ready and not yet scheduled in the Instagram app, soonest first.

**To schedule one:** save its images, then in Instagram tap **+ → Post**, pick the images in the order shown, tap **Next**, paste the caption, open **More options → Schedule this post**, set the time, and tap **Schedule**. Then mark it done: ask Claude, or set `"status": "scheduled"` in its `post.json`.
